title: Fix incorrect line numbers when Luau code wraps on phone
changes: Fix Android editor gutter displaying line 6 beside the seventh actual source line when a long line wraps
Measure per-source-line visual height so wrapped statements reserve their extra rows before the next line number
Keep line counts based on real newlines: a seven-line script is numbered 1 through 7 even with soft wrapping
Automatically recalculate numbered gutter positions when the editor width, word wrap or font settings change
Synchronize Luau syntax highlighting and editable textarea wrap behavior while preserving all saved script contents
Add regression tests for wrapped lines, phone width changes and disabled word wrap
